text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit packages, and created the API route and frontend components exactly as the quickstart specifies. The copilot runtime endpoint demonstrably works: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/copilotkit/info` returned HTTP 200 with valid JSON showing `"version":"1.69.3"`, the `BuiltInAgent`, and `"mode":"sse"`. However, the Next.js dev server repeatedly crashed or hung when compiling the frontend page at `/`, so I could not verify that the full app serves the CopilotSidebar UI. No OpenAI or Intelligence API keys were present in the environment, which would have blocked actual chat functionality even if the page had loaded.
